instruction: How to delete all qdiscs from a device
output: tc qdisc del dev eth0 root

instruction: How to delete all filters from a device
output: tc filter del dev eth0

instruction: How to delete all classes from a device
output: tc class del dev eth0

instruction: How to add a qdisc with handle and replace class
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: htb && tc class replace dev eth0 parent 1: classid 1:10 htb rate 5mbit

instruction: How to change an HTB class rate
output: tc class change dev eth0 classid 1:10 htb rate 2mbit

instruction: How to change a TBF rate
output: tc qdisc change dev eth0 root tbf rate 5mbit burst 64kbit latency 50ms

instruction: How to change netem loss rate
output: tc qdisc change dev eth0 root netem loss 15%

instruction: How to add an ingress qdisc and redirect to ifb
output: modprobe ifb && ip link set ifb0 up && tc qdisc add dev eth0 ingress && tc filter add dev eth0 parent ffff: protocol ip u32 match u32 0 0 action mirred egress redirect dev ifb0

instruction: How to set up ifb for egress shaping only
output: ip link set ifb0 up && tc qdisc add dev ifb0 root handle 1: htb default 30 && tc class add dev ifb0 parent 1: classid 1:10 htb rate 10mbit

instruction: How to combine ingress policing with HTB
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 ingress && tc filter add dev eth0 parent ffff: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip src 10.0.0.1 police rate 1mbit burst 10k drop && tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: htb

instruction: How to use tc to simulate delay on a veth tunnel
output: tc qdisc add dev vxlan0 root netem delay 50ms

instruction: How to set up tc on a multiqueue device
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root mqprio num_tc 4 map 0 1 2 3 queues 1@0 1@1 1@2 1@3 hw 0

instruction: How to set up HFSC with real-time service curve
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: hfsc default 30 && tc class add dev eth0 parent 1: classid 1:10 hfsc sc rate 1mbit ul rate 10mbit

instruction: How to add a filter with a BPF program via tc
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: bpf da obj /tmp/bpf_prog.o flowid 1:10

instruction: How to load a cls_bpf object file
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: bpf da obj bpf_prog.o sec classifier

instruction: How to show BPF filter details in tc
output: tc filter show dev eth0 parent 1: bpf

instruction: How to pin a BPF program for tc
output: bpftool prog load bpf_prog.o /sys/fs/bpf/myprog type classifier

instruction: How to attach a pinned BPF program to tc
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: bpf pinned /sys/fs/bpf/myprog flowid 1:10

instruction: How to set up EBPF for tc using libbpf
output: tc filter add dev eth0 egress bpf obj ebpf_prog.o sec tc/egress

instruction: How to add a DCB (Data Center Bridging) qdisc
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: mqprio && tc qdisc add dev eth0 parent 1:1 handle 10: ets strict 3

instruction: How to add a qdisc on an OVS internal port
output: tc qdisc add dev ovs-system root handle 1: htb default 30

instruction: How to mirror traffic to another interface with tc
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match u32 0 0 action mirred egress mirror dev eth1

instruction: How to set up traffic shaping based on packet length
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match u16 0x0000 0xfc00 at 2 action police rate 1mbit burst 1k conform-exceed drop/continue

instruction: How to add a filter that matches on IP TTL
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match u8 150 0xff at 8 flowid 1:10

instruction: How to test tc filter before deploying
output: tc filter show dev eth0 parent 1: && echo 'Use tc monitor to test'
